task_admitted_dispatch_runs_in_the_servi: Task admitted. Dispatch runs in the service; this page renews only explicitly acquired control.
task_start_outcome_unknown_find_the_orig: Task start outcome unknown. Find the original task below; do not create a replacement automatically.
cancellation_requested_inspect_the_final: Cancellation requested. Inspect the final task result; issued frames cannot be recalled.
cancellation_response_unavailable_refres: Cancellation response unavailable. Refresh the task result; cancellation is not assumed complete.
uses_the_frame_editor_above_requires_a_r: Uses the frame editor above. Requires a running active session and explicit control. Submission does not confirm bus delivery.
reloading_restores_results_only_control_: Reloading restores results only. Control must be acquired explicitly; no task is restarted.
recovered: Recovered task {{id}}: {{state}}. No control was acquired or renewed.
notFound: No retained task matches. Results may have expired or the service may have restarted; this does not prove nonexecution.
plan_value: Plan: {{frames}} frames, {{interval}} ms apart; last dispatch after {{seconds}} seconds. Skipped slots are not retried.
